_period_comment: weekly | biweekly | sprint | monthly | custom — sets the default date range, folder rhythm and deck title

theme._comment: Optional hex colours that override the style's palette (dark, accent, accentLight, warning)

team._comment: Map BOTH git author names AND GitHub logins to the display names used in the deck

projects._comment: Map local repo folder names to project/service names (optional; the skill asks when a repo is missing)

tasks._comment: Your project/task tool: provider = none | lark | jira | linear | asana | clickup. Tokens go in environment variables, never here.

clickup._comment: Or use { "workspaceId": "9012345", "spaces": ["90123"] } for a whole workspace

taskUsers._comment: Map task-tool user ids, emails or names to display names

exclude._comment: People left out of the report: task-tool ids/names/emails, git author names or GitHub logins
